name: Shintoku (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Shintoku town emblem in white and red: a broken ring enclosing the character 新 in red above 市 in white.
history: Municipal flag of Shintoku, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 February 1948.

features.role: Shintoku town emblem — a broken ring enclosing the character 新 in red above 市 in white
